contracts.declared_mechanism: Shared-secret header gate inside the FastAPI handler: the X-Callback-Token header (bound via FastAPI Header alias) is compared to os.getenv("CALLBACK_TOKEN").strip(); an unset/empty configured token raises HTTPException 503 (fail closed) and a missing or mismatched header raises HTTPException 401, both raised before any bridge_request_store mutation. The authorized sender (local_bridge/callback_client.post_result_callback) attaches the same shared secret as header {"X-Callback-Token": callback_token} on the callback POST.
